subject.title: feat(discord/voice): add sessionChannelId to autoJoin for text-channel transcript routing

question: Should Discord voice text mirroring be configured as a per-`autoJoin` `sessionChannelId`, through the existing `voice.agentSession` target surface, or deferred until a broader voice-as-I/O design is approved?
rationale: The remaining work changes public Discord voice config and delivery/security semantics, and current main already has a partially overlapping `voice.agentSession` target path, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Extend `voice.agentSession` with mirroring
options.body: Use the existing target-session surface as the canonical routing contract and add explicit transcript/reply mirroring semantics there if maintainers want automatic text output.

options.title: Land per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId`
options.body: Accept the contributor’s narrower fixed-room design, but require same-guild target validation, explicit delivery target handling, docs, tests, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Defer automatic text mirroring
options.body: Keep the shipped `voice.agentSession` routing-only behavior and close or re-scope this feature if visible transcript/reply mirroring is not desired now.

recommendation.title: Extend `voice.agentSession` with mirroring
recommendation.body: Use the existing target-session surface as the canonical routing contract and add explicit transcript/reply mirroring semantics there if maintainers want automatic text output.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Discord voice routing and docs history, plus the detailed review comment on this issue, make this the strongest available owner for the product-direction call.
